kind: gen_input (VASP relax+static input sets + generated tube)
provenance: rubric and reference from 3_reproduction/L3/ (run 20260601_li_L3_opus_think); as-run relax INCAR/KPOINTS at hpc_computations/n08_relax

structure_match.note: the seed's two atoms pin the rotation about the axis, the B/N polarity, AND the honeycomb handedness (a mirror build puts a B where the seed N sits); the build must match our orientation. fallback is polarity-safe. The two runs submit the same as-built tube (the prompt says so; the agent cannot produce the relaxed geometry). The relaxed tube ~ as-built within 0.1 A, so an as-relaxed POSCAR also passes.
structure_match.applies_to: both runs (relax and static submit the same as-built POSCAR)

incar_required.current_rules: See grader.py, reviewer notes and graderlib for effective-value rules. Fixed-cell relaxations accept ISIF 0/1/2 and IBRION 1/2/3 with positive NSW, free internal coordinates and the existing force threshold. Static EDIFF <=1e-5 eV; relaxation EDIFF <=5e-5 eV per atom. Both stages are charge-updating self-consistent PBE; initialization files may be supplied or, for static CHGCAR, produced by an earlier valid relaxation with LCHARG enabled. Finite graded numbers and valid integers are required. Gaussian and Fermi-Dirac are accepted; the 1-D mesh excludes tetrahedron. Static output may be ionic+Hartree or total including XC. Extra Hubbard checks are not applied. Existing mesh, structure and dipole rules remain.

kmesh_reference.note: As-run reproduction mesh provenance. Grading uses the separate frozen kmesh_policy; centering and vacuum requirements remain independent.

score: 1 only if both runs pass structure match AND their REQUIRED INCAR/KPOINTS rubric (all checks must pass; any single failure scores 0)

kmesh_policy.source: Trusted reference input cell per run label; geometry-based density shared by VASP, QE and ABACUS. No inference from submitted settings.
kmesh_policy.rule: Each periodic-axis subdivision >= automatic default, without subtraction or relative margin. Vacuum axes are exactly 1. Berry strings retain their independent longitudinal condition.
